name: Garlic (food medium)
description: Food-derived medium: metabolizable components of Garlic (Allium sativum) [Herbs and Spices] from FooDB, plus a standard M9 mineral base. Organic components use presence-based uptake bounds; FooDB content retained. Measured compounds with no BiGG exchange are listed under uncovered.

provenance.citation: FooDB v2020-04-07 (Wishart DS et al., foodb.ca). Content sources: DTU, MANUAL, USDA.
provenance.notes: Organic components mapped from FooDB compounds to BiGG via InChIKey/name. Mineral base added. Bounds presence-based; foodb_content retained. Unmapped measured compounds kept in uncovered (v2 completeness fix). IMPORTANT: composition values are taken from the archived FooDB 2020-04-07 CSV data release; FooDB's live food page no longer displays this bulk composition, so it will appear empty. Verify individual compounds via the per-component cross-reference links. Underlying content was aggregated by FooDB from USDA / DTU / Phenol Explorer.
provenance.verification: expert-curated (multi-source food composition; growth-relevant profile completed, FooDB noise removed)
curation_sources: USDA FoodData Central FDC 169230 (Garlic, raw) — full macro/mineral/vitamin/amino-acid panel
Baumgartner et al. 2000 J Agric Food Chem doi:10.1021/jf970433u (garlic fructan/FOS molecular size)
Judprasong et al. 2011 J Food Comp Anal (fructan content of foods)
IISTE Food Science & Quality Management — free glucose/fructose/sucrose/total fructan in Allium
Springer 2025 doi:10.1007/s44345-025-00036-6 (fresh-to-black garlic physicochemical review; organic acids)
Allium organic-acid survey (citric/malic/pyruvic/oxalic in fresh garlic)
Linus Pauling Institute, Oregon State University — garlic organosulfur (alliin, gamma-glutamylcysteines)
provenance.curation_notes: Dominant carbon/energy source is FRUCTAN (inulin-type FOS, ~17 g/100g) — an order of magnitude larger than the free sugars (total ~1 g/100g, fructose > sucrose >> glucose); a fructan-capable microbe grows on garlic chiefly via fructan/fructose. Organic acids (citric ~1 g, malic ~0.3 g, plus pyruvate) were entirely absent from the FooDB profile and are added here. curation_added: fructan (inulin-type FOS) — the dominant fermentable carbon source, previously absent
citric acid, malic acid, pyruvic acid, oxalic acid, fumaric acid (organic acids — all previously missing)
sucrose, D-fructose, D-glucose with individual amounts (only sucrose name was present, unquantified)
alliin and gamma-glutamyl-S-allyl-L-cysteine (defining organosulfur N/S pools)
quantitative amino-acid profile, full mineral panel, and vitamin panel from USDA

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
